'''Spaceport Security''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]]. They responded to an altercation between a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-allied team of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[House Mecetti]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] in [[Docking Bay 10]].<ref name="MF">{{WEGCite|story=The Mecetti File|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
